name: Flupirtine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in European Union, first in 2018 — for liver harm

similar.name: Cloforex
problems: Pulled from the market in Germany and Sweden, first in 1969 — for breathing problems and heart harm

summary: In 2018, the drug Flupirtine was pulled from the market in the European Union due to liver harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave it a high score of 79 for liver risk and a low score of 35 for heart risk [M]. Additionally, a similar drug named Cloforex was removed from the market in Germany and Sweden in 1969 because of breathing and heart harm [4].
